## Overview

In collegiate athletics, players often improve as they progress through their college careers. But **does experience level substantially affect individual volleyball statistics**?

To answer this question, we collected comprehensive individual season statistics across six seasons of NCAA Division 1 women's volleyball (2020–2026), covering over 31,000 player-seasons across four class standings:

- **Freshmen (Fr)**
- **Sophomores (So)**
- **Juniors (Jr)**
- **Seniors (Sr)**

```{r}
#| label: points-by-class-plot
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-align: center
library(tidyverse)

volleyball <- read_csv("data/ncaa_d1_volleyball_2020_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

volleyball |>
  filter(Yr %in% c("Fr", "So", "Jr", "Sr"), S >= 20, !is.na(PTS)) |>
  mutate(
    class_year = factor(Yr, levels = c("Fr", "So", "Jr", "Sr"),
                        labels = c("Freshman", "Sophomore", "Junior", "Senior")),
    points_s = PTS / S
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = class_year, y = points_s, color = class_year)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.12, size = 0.75, width = 0.28, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Points per Set by Class Standing",
    subtitle = "Each point represents an individual player-season (25,000+ observations)",
    x = "Class Standing",
    y = "Points per Set",
    caption = "Source: NCAA Division 1 Volleyball Statistics (2020–2026)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Core Findings

As players progress from freshman to senior year:

1. **Total Scoring**: Seniors average **1.78 points per set**, compared to **1.28** for freshmen (+39%).
2. **Attacking Volume & Efficiency**: Seniors average **1.39 kills per set** with a **.185** average hitting percentage, compared to **0.98 kills per set** and **.141** hitting percentage for freshmen.
3. **Net Defense**: Blocks per set increase from **0.28** (freshmen) to **0.37** (seniors) (+32%).
4. **Floor Defense**: Digs per set increase from **1.20** (freshmen) to **1.53** (seniors) (+28%).
5. **Serving & Setting**: Service aces and assists also rise as players take on expanded rotation duties.
